snippet.title: Dragon Age 2 - Rogue Pack DLC (Part 1/2)
snippet.description:
http://www.shockblastmedia.com - a look at where to find the all three DLC packs, including the Rogue Pack DLC for Dragon Age 2. As you can see (the question had been asked), you have to be at least a level 6 or 15 to use to pieces of the DLC. Weak sauce. They do, however, level up as you do, which makes way more sense. I will make a second video as soon as I get to the required level and can use both pieces.

Warrior DLC Pack - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IJgEthk2K9w
Mage DLC Pack - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J4yuifJCBIk
Rogue DLC Pack (Part 1) - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tp0FLwYZd2I
Rogue DLC Pack (Part 2) - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ggbkCwaAerE
